title: A Hybrid Framework for Explainable Aviation Risk: Causal Chain Extraction from Safety Reports with Physics-Based Failure Quantification and Interventional Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.35658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aviation authorities hold decades of accident reports whose narratives record how investigators reconstructed each accident. Computational work on these archives has mostly sorted reports into fixed taxonomies. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework in which a text-based corpus identifies the leading factors of a failure mode. Physics-based models then quantify how likely that failure is at a stated operating point. Ordered causal chains extracted from 56,202 American accident reports with a local large language model aggregate into a causation knowledge graph. On an evaluation sample of 2,000 reports, the chains recover 90.8% of investigator-flagged causes. Each physical factor whose drivers the record carries receives an occurrence model calibrated to the accident population. translated_title: 面向可解释航空风险的混合框架：基于安全报告的因果链提取、基于物理的失效量化与干预分析
translated_abstract: 航空管理机构保存着数十年积累的事故报告，其中的叙述记录了调查人员如何重建每一起事故。针对这些档案的现有计算研究大多只是将报告归入固定的分类体系。在本工作中，我们提出一种混合框架：首先由基于文本的语料库识别出某一失效模式的主导因素，随后由基于物理的模型量化该失效在给定运行工况下发生的可能性。利用本地部署的大语言模型，从56,202份美国事故报告中提取有序因果链，并聚合为因果知识图谱。在2,000份报告的评估样本上，这些因果链恢复了90.8%的调查人员所标注的原因。对于记录中带有驱动因素的每个物理因素，都建立了一个针对事故总体进行校准的发生模型。一个拟合于语料库的漏泄噪声OR（leaky noisy-OR）模型将这些因素组合为失效模式概率，从而支持干预分析。对于发动机动力丧失情形，化油器（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种混合框架，利用本地大语言模型从5.6万余份美国航空事故报告中提取因果链并构建因果知识图谱，结合基于物理的失效发生模型与漏泄噪声OR方法，将文本因素量化为失效模式概率，实现可解释的航空风险量化与干预分析，其提取的因果链可恢复90.8%的调查人员标注原因。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid framework that uses a local large language model to extract causal chains from 56,202 U.S. aviation accident reports into a causation knowledge graph, and combines physics-based occurrence models with a leaky noisy-OR to quantify failure mode probabilities for explainable, intervention-supporting aviation risk analysis, recovering 90.8% of investigator-flagged causes.
